analysis.title: GS Contessa - US EQUITIES COLOR: UNCH 28 Oct 2026
key_insights: S&P 500 closed +28bps at 7,744 with a MOC imbalance of $1.3bn to sell. NDX +55bps at 29,813, R2K +15bps at 2,823, Dow +19bps at 52,476. Volume was 16.606bn shares vs a YTD daily average of 18.494bn.

The GS desk attributes the flat-to-firmer tape to cleared capital raise overhangs (META, SPCX), better tech prints overnight (SKHY, VRT), ORCL (+10%) reaffirming its 2027 guide at its investor day, and a Fed decision that was a non-event.

MSFT was up 4% after hours on a beat. Total revenue growth was +19% y/y vs +17% y/y cc last quarter. Azure growth was +48%, up from +43% last quarter, but the desk notes this was prior to the re-segmentation, so it is not like-for-like.
GOOGL was down 7% after hours. Cloud growth was solid, but Search growth of +12% vs expectations of +14% will likely feed a share-loss narrative, per the desk.

Flow: the desk saw early demand in AI/Semis after 2-3 weeks of little offense, mainly from long-only accounts. Asset managers and hedge funds finished small net buyers. The desk rated floor activity 4 on a 1-10 scale.

FOMC held the fed funds target at 3.75-4.00%. Governor Cook and President Hammack dissented, preferring a 25bp hike. The statement upgraded economic activity to 'strong' from 'solid' and kept inflation as 'elevated'.
Cross-asset closes: VIX -565bps at 16.53, WTI +139bps at $101.27, US 10Y unchanged at 5.0217%, gold +50bps at 4,072, DXY -16bps at 102.16, Bitcoin +115bps at $81,584.
